item.title: Silverdale Signing Day Bonanza Reflects Commitment to Athletics
item.description: Chattanooga-(WDEF-TV) If you’ve been on the Silverdale campus in recent years, you can’t help but notice all the upgrades in their athletic facilities. That commitment to athletics showed up on national signing day, as nearly 20 athletes inked college scholarships. Brian Armstrong reports. Categories: Sports – Local Sports News
